programme.notes: Programme page as recorded in kb_imported_dev.json (not re-researched in this top-up).

english.quote: Das Studium an der LMU setzt ausreichende Deutschkenntnisse voraus (Ausnahme: englischsprachige Master- und Promotionsprogramme).
english.notes: Informatik (Bachelor) is German-taught ('Studiensprache Deutsch' on the programme page). No English test; German proof required: DSH 2, TestDaF 4 in all four parts, telc Deutsch C1 Hochschule, DSD II, Goethe C2, ÖSD C2, etc. For a locally restricted (zulassungsbeschränkt) subject such as Informatik, non-EU applicants must submit the certificate by the application deadline (15 July / 15 January); 'Nachreichungen sind nicht möglich!'

gpa.notes: No grade minimum published. Informatik is 'Örtliche Zulassungsbeschränkung' (local numerus clausus) for the 1st semester; selection by grade ranking, cut-offs not published on the pages read.

deadline.quote: Bewerbungsfristen 15. Januar für das Sommersemester 15. Juli für das Wintersemester (Ausschlussfrist)
deadline.notes: International Office applications (non-EU applicants with foreign school-leaving certificates). Informatik starts only in the winter semester ('Studienbeginn nur im Wintersemester'), so 15 July 2027 for WS 2027/28 (year not printed). From summer semester 2027 LMU works with uni-assist: a VPD must be obtained first (processing up to 8 weeks); 'Die LMU gestaltet den Bewerbungs- und Immatrikulationsprozess ab dem Sommersemester 2027 neu.'

tuition.notes: No tuition-fee statement found. The programme page lists only 'Beiträge: Die Universität erhebt für das Studentenwerk München den Grundbeitrag ...'; https://www.lmu.de/de/workspace-fuer-studierende/1x1-des-studiums/studierendenwerksbeitraege/ gives 'Sommersemester 2026: Grundbeitrag 97,00 €' per semester. No page read states explicitly that LMU charges no tuition to non-EU students, so not recorded as known.
